environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium) behind a classic ELB with no additional middleware. The service listens on port 8080, ELB forwards TCP/443 -> TCP/8080. No WAF, no API Gateway, no reverse proxy with filtering. The /var/data/uploads directory is served directly by the Ktor application. The uploaded files directory is also accessible via a secondary nginx vhost on port 8081 configured with `autoindex on` for debugging purposes, which executes .jsp/.html/.svg files when accessed through the nginx-embedded scripting module.

config.file_serving: Ktor direct + nginx on :8081 with autoindex
config.network: Public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on 443,8081
